## Code Review

This pull request updates the NPU patch for Qwen3 MoE models to support newer transformers API versions while maintaining backward compatibility with legacy block APIs. It introduces a helper function to detect legacy blocks, dynamically extracts routing parameters and expert weights (handling both split and fused gate/up projections), and conditionally adjusts the return signature of the forward passes based on the detected API version. I have no feedback to provide as there are no review comments.
